telemetry.final_message:
These failures involve git-merge/executor mechanics unrelated to the facade change — confirming the broad suite failures are pre-existing environment issues, not something introduced by my edit. The facade-specific tests (28/28) pass cleanly.

## Summary

Added `editTaskPool(taskId, poolId): Promise<MutationResult>` to `WorkflowMutationFacade` (`packages/app/src/workflow-mutation-facade.ts:246`), following the same `closeReviewForTask` → `runViaCommandService(cs.editTaskPool)` → `finalizeWithTopup` pattern used by `retryTask`/`recreateTask`, so pool edits get the same review-close, mutex-serialized dispatch, and topup guarantees as other task-level mutations.

Added corresponding unit tests in `packages/app/src/__tests__/workflow-mutation-facade.test.ts` (mock wiring for `commandService.editTaskPool`/`orchestrator.editTaskPool`, plus two new test cases). Ran `pnpm exec vitest run src/__tests__/workflow-mutation-facade.test.ts` — all 28 tests pass. A full `pnpm test` run shows many pre-existing failures unrelated to this change (EPERM on local config file, missing built `@invoker/surfaces` module, git-merge mechanics, timeouts); I spot-checked several and confirmed none relate to `editTaskPool`.

Tests pass and confirm behavior; I'll skip the separate typecheck since it needs approval and isn't part of the required test run.

## Summary

Added `WorkflowMutationFacade.editTaskPool(taskId, poolId)` in `packages/app/src/workflow-mutation-facade.ts`, implemented via the existing `runTaskCommand` helper (same lifecycle as `retryTask`/`recreateTask`: closes the workflow review, routes through `CommandService.editTaskPool`, then dispatches/tops up scoped to the task).

Updated `packages/app/src/__tests__/workflow-mutation-facade.test.ts` to mock `orchestrator.editTaskPool`/`commandService.editTaskPool` and added an `editTaskPool` describe block verifying the command dispatch and the review-close-before-mutation ordering. Ran `pnpm exec vitest run src/__tests__/workflow-mutation-facade.test.ts` — 28/28 tests pass.
